**Verdict: ready**

## Build and tests

I merged `origin/main` 7491ce4d6 into head d9815d977 in a local worktree (merge 4c6d10755, no conflicts). I pushed nothing. Debug, `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=6`, on Windows:

- `camcraft-app --test thread_mill`: 8 passed, 0 failed.
- `camcraft-app --test thread_boss`: 12 passed, 0 failed.
- `camcraft-app --test first_part_programs` (pins `examples/first-router-part.nc`): 2 passed, 0 failed.
- `camcraft-app --test first_router_part`: 4 passed, 0 failed.
- `camcraft-ui --lib -- guide_projects`: 3 passed, 0 failed (the new `default_projects_dir_belongs_to_this_process` included).
- After the ui run, no `camcraft-guide-projects-<pid>` directory stays in the temp directory. The cleanup works on the success path.

## Findings

No blockers.

1. Thread goldens (`crates/app/tests/golden/nc/thread_mill_m8_multi_form.nc`, `thread_mill_external_m8_multi_form.nc`). I read each changed line. Only the tool comment, the `T` word and the `H` word change. No coordinate, feed or speed changes. In each operation the comment, `T` and `H` numbers agree. The goldens have no `D` word. The new numbers follow the order of `AddTool` in the fixtures:
   - internal: `world_with` adds the thread mill (T01), then `drill_ahead` adds `TAP-DRILL` (T02);
   - external: `stud_bare` adds `MULTI`, `SINGLE`, `ENDMILL` in that order, so `EM-1000-4FL` is T03 and the thread mill is T01.
2. G73 depth in `examples/first-router-part.nc:13`. The example drills four through holes with a Ø6 drill, tip angle 118, `floor_z` 0, `entry_z` 12, `break_through_from: full_diameter`, and the default break-through of 1 mm.
   - Point length: 3 / tan(59°) = 3 / 1.6643 = 1.8026 mm.
   - Model bottom: 0 - 1.0 - 1.8026 = -2.8026. The cached `bottom_z` in the `.camproj` is -2.802582.
   - The posted Z is relative to the stock top at 12 (`R0` = model Z 12): -2.8026 - 12 = -14.803.
   - The old -13 was 0 - 1 - 12: the tip at 1 mm past the bottom, with the full diameter short of the bottom.
   - Safety: the full diameter goes 1 mm into the spoilboard, which is the break-through value. The tip goes 2.803 mm. This is the purpose of #2504. The project's own note says the same ("through holes run 2.803 mm past the part bottom"). `site/content/guide/getting-started/first-router-part.md` (lines 41, 77, 105) on main already gives `Z-14.803`. Thus the new depth is the intent of the example, and the old pin was out of date.
3. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/guide_projects.rs`. The directory name has the process id, so parallel test processes do not share it. Threads in one process share it, but only one non-ignored test writes to it. The code uses `std::env::temp_dir` and `std::process::id`, so it works on Windows, Linux and macOS. The assertions of `demo_projects_build_and_load_with_valid_paths` are not weaker. The test removes the directory only when it is its own directory, never the `CAMCRAFT_GUIDE_PROJECTS_OUT` directory. Non-blockers:
   - There is no drop guard. If the test fails, the `<pid>` directory stays. The name is unique, so this has no effect on the result of a later run. It only leaves a few files in the temp directory.
   - With `--include-ignored` and no `CAMCRAFT_GUIDE_PROJECTS_OUT`, the ignored `render_all_guide_images` (guide_images.rs:233) uses the same `<pid>` directory. The removal can then delete its input during its run. No gate tier does this: `cargo xtask docs-images` sets the variable, and the snapshot lane filters on `snapshot`.
   - The new pin test compares `own_projects_dir()` with its own formula. It proves that the default is no longer the fixed shared name, but it does not prove the "Permission denied" fix. Only the next post-merge run on the Linux runner proves that, as the PR body says.
4. Laws. The PR has no snapshot PNG, no `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` change and no workflow file. The body has `Changelog: none` (correct for tests and pins) and `Fixes #2543`. The decision file `docs/decisions/2543-main-red-posts.md` is present. The `#[test]` count of `crates/ui` goes from 1326 to 1327.

## Not exercised

- I did not run the ui test on the Linux runner account that owns `/tmp/camcraft-guide-projects`.
- I did not run clippy, the quick gate or the batch gate.
- I did not run `camcraft-cli process` again to compare the `.nc` byte by byte. `first_part_programs` makes this comparison and passes.

Merge class: reviewed head, no refresh. This merge relies on the independent review of head d9815d977 (comment 6984757629), which built and ran the four tests on the merge with main 7491ce4d6. This PR is a fix for a red main and is always in a cut.
